name: WeatherAPI.com
summary: Worldwide current weather, forecasts up to 14 days, historical weather back to 2010, long-range future weather, alerts, marine and astronomy data, plus location search.

api_key.description: A WeatherAPI.com API key (account dashboard). Sent as the key query parameter.

notes: Plan gates: forecast is 3-14 days depending on plan; future.json (14-300 days ahead) is Pro+; history end_dt ranges are Pro+; minutely rain is Starter+; alerts are limited on Free.
Dates are yyyy-MM-dd; unixdt/unixend_dt are the Unix-timestamp alternatives (never send both forms).

q.description: Location: city name, 'lat,lon' decimals, US zip, UK or Canada postcode, metar:<code>, iata:<code>, auto:ip, an IP address, or id:<id> from search.

lang.description: Language code for condition text, e.g. fr.

current_fields.description: Comma-separated fields to keep, e.g. temp_c,wind_mph.
